description: User specifies: the agent is the application interface. Voice/text change requests become Beadwork tickets, tied to the selected stable component and evidence. Persist this contract in project instructions and public agent-readable knowledge. Clarify that unsent browser-local text is not automatically transmitted to the agent. Preserve browser save/backup as optional fallback. Acceptance: workflow documented, knowledge rebuilt, required checks pass, public deployment succeeds, ticket closed with commit/deployment and review instructions.
